name: Veteran Guard Captain
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-08: Revolution on the Riverside

items.name: Greataxe
items.description: This large battle axe is too heavy to wield with only one hand. Many greataxes incorporate two blades, and they are often "bearded", having a hook at the bottom to increase the strength of their chopping power.

items.name: Half Plate
items.description: Half plate consists of most of the upper body plates used in full plate, with lighter or sparser steel plate protection for the arms and legs. This provides some of the protection of full plate with greater flexibility and speed. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of padded armor and a pair of gauntlets.

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Power Attack
offensiveAbilities.description:
The guard captain makes a melee Strike.

This counts as two attacks when calculating the multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, it deals an extra a die of weapon damage.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sudden Charge
offensiveAbilities.description: The guard captain Strides twice. If the guard captain ends their movement within a melee reach of at least one enemy, they can make a melee Strike against that enemy.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swipe
offensiveAbilities.description: The guard captain makes a single melee Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes, each of whom must be within the guard captain's melee reach and adjacent to the other. Roll damage only once and apply it to each creature the guard captain hits. A swipe counts as two attacks for the multiple attack penalty. The modifier of a weapon with a sweep trait applies to all attacks.
